units.source_text: “噢……”我只应了一声，就在这坐垫上坐了下来。

en.t: Oh... I only answered with that one sound, then sat down on the cushion.

units.source_text: 由于爬坡气喘和惊慌，连“谢谢”这句话也卡在嗓子眼里说不出来。

en.t: Because I was out of breath from climbing the slope and was flustered, even the words thank you stuck in my throat and would not come out.
